title: 専門ゼミ
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
teachers: 授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Develop the basic academic and technical skills necessary to undertake Project Design III.
advice:
Necessary learning for projects implemented in Project Design III will be conducted based on each activity's program area.
Students learn about safety management, engineering ethics, and career design.
Students identify project objectives and action plans and understand their contents and implementation methods.
Students create project proposals for Project Design III.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and skills acquired in required subjects

activityGoals.body: Students develop a clear image of Project Design III project goals and action plans.
Students can explain the theme of their Project Design III project.
Students acquire knowledge and skills that can be used independently in Project Design III.
Students can plan their career paths after graduation.
Students examine the relationship between their post-graduation career path and the theme of Project Design III.
